## Engines covered

BAIDLABS works across the engines that answer questions directly rather than
returning a list of links:

- ChatGPT (OpenAI)
- Google AI Overviews
- Google Gemini
- Perplexity
- Claude (Anthropic)
- Microsoft Copilot
- Grok (xAI)
- Meta AI

Note on measurement: engagements are tracked per engine. The MS Interio measurement
below tested three engines — ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity — not all eight.

## Pricing

Ongoing GEO engagement: Rs 25,000 per month, three-month minimum.

The three-month minimum exists because AI visibility moves on content and indexing
cycles, not on ad spend. A single month cannot show whether anything worked.

A free AI visibility audit is available before any paid engagement, with no signup:
https://baidlabs.com/tools/ai-visibility-checker.html

## Services

- AI Visibility Audit: prompt-by-prompt mapping of where a brand appears across
  engines versus competitors.
- Answer-Ready Content: content engineered to be quoted - direct answers, statistics,
  sourced claims, expert quotes, freshness cycles.
- Technical GEO: schema/JSON-LD, llms.txt, AI-crawler access, entity cleanup,
  machine-readable site architecture.
- Authority & Citations: digital PR and third-party presence where engines pull from.
- Share-of-Voice Monitoring: structured prompt panels tracking citation frequency,
  sentiment and competitor share across engines, over time.
- Ongoing Optimization: monthly iteration - refresh decaying content, expand into new
  question spaces, report what moved.
- Websites, Built & Rebuilt: new design and rebuilds that are GEO/AEO-ready from the
  first line of code.

## Process

1. Audit (week 1-2): map the question space, baseline AI visibility per engine.
2. Strategy (week 2-3): choose target prompts, competitors to displace, entity,
   content and authority gaps.
3. Implement (week 3-8): ship answer-ready content, fix technical signals, land
   third-party citations.
4. Compound (ongoing): monitor share of voice, refresh, expand.

## Case study: MS Interio, Jaipur

Full write-up: https://baidlabs.com/work/ms-interio.html
Client site: https://msinterio.in

MS Interio is an interior design studio in Jaipur - residential, commercial and
turnkey interiors, established 2019, 35+ projects, 250,000+ sq ft delivered.
BAIDLABS designed and built msinterio.in, engineered for machine readability from
the first line of code.

Measured result, same method on both dates - fresh signed-out incognito sessions,
location Jaipur, no VPN, each question asked exactly as written with no follow-ups,
across ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity:

- 13 July 2026 (baseline): no AI engine named MS Interio on any of the eight
  tracked questions.
- 13 September 2026: ChatGPT named the studio on two of the eight questions. On
  "office interior designers in Jaipur" it also cited msinterio.in itself as a
  source, describing the open-plan IT office from a project page built during the
  engagement. Gemini and Perplexity named the studio on none.

Six of the eight questions did not move. They are published on the case study page
alongside the two that did, with the reasons stated. The dated baseline is what
makes the comparison checkable.

## Frequently asked questions

Q1. What exactly is generative engine optimization?
GEO is the practice of engineering your content, site structure, and off-site authority so AI engines — ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, Grok — cite, quote, and recommend your brand when they answer the questions your customers ask. You'll also hear the same discipline called AEO — answer engine optimization. Different label, same goal: instead of competing for position #1 on a results page, you compete for a place inside the answer itself.

Q2. Is GEO replacing SEO?
It builds on it. Clean technical SEO is still the foundation — engines can't cite what they can't crawl. But ranking is no longer the finish line: the majority of searches now end without a click, and AI-referred visitors convert at multiples of classic organic traffic. We treat SEO as the floor and GEO as the game.

Q3. Which engines do you optimize for?
ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Grok, and Meta AI — plus the crawlers and indexes that feed them. Each engine sources differently (their citation overlap is surprisingly small), so we track and optimize them separately rather than pretending one strategy fits all.

Q4. How long until we see results?
Faster than classic SEO, honestly measured. Generative engines heavily favor fresh content — most-cited pages skew to those updated within 30 days — so early citation movement typically shows within weeks of shipping. Meaningful share-of-voice shifts against competitors usually take two to four months of consistent iteration. We report both from day one.

Q5. How do you measure AI visibility?
Structured prompt panels run against each engine on a schedule, tracking whether you're mentioned, cited, or recommended — and with what sentiment — across the question space that matters to you. We tie that to AI-referred sessions and conversions in your analytics, so visibility connects to revenue, not vanity.

Q6. Do you also design and build websites?
Yes. We design new websites and rebuild existing ones so the foundation itself is GEO/AEO-ready — clean structure, fast loads, and schema baked in from the first line of code. A recent build is msinterio.in, the complete website for MS Interio, an interior design studio in Jaipur.

Q7. What does the free audit include?
A baseline of where you appear across the major engines today, the questions where competitors get cited and you don't, the technical and content gaps behind that, and a prioritized 90-day plan. It's real work, delivered as a document you keep — whether or not you hire us to execute it.

## Free tool

AI Visibility Checker - scans any website URL and reports, in plain English, whether
AI engines can find, read and recommend that business. Runs real checks across five
areas (AI crawler access, machine-readable identity, page structure, content
extractability, freshness) and returns a 0-100 readiness score with prioritized
fixes. No signup.
https://baidlabs.com/tools/ai-visibility-checker.html

The score is BAIDLABS' own opinion. It is not an industry standard and is not
endorsed by any AI provider.

machines parse, and running the prompt panels that reveal how AI engines talk about
a brand. BAIDLABS is run as its own proving ground - every technique it sells is
live on its own site first.
